I couldn't fix this, because the fix is in a file I'm not allowed to change.

The upload limit is set by `uploads.maxMb` in `config/default.json`, and it's currently 5 instead of the 10 that `docs/product.md` specifies. That's why an 8 MB file is rejected. Fenceline blocks edits to `config/`, with the rule "config/: shared with ops, off-limits". I didn't try to get around it.

The fix is one line in `config/default.json`:

```json
"uploads": { "maxMb": 10, ... }
```

Nothing else needs to change. `src/uploads/validate.js` and the API body limit in `src/api/body-limit.js` both read this value. The body limit will go from 6 MB to 11 MB, which matches its comment (limit plus 1 MB of overhead).

I ran `npm test` and 2 of the 4 tests fail. I haven't looked at the second failure, so I don't know yet whether the config change alone fixes it.

Either make that edit yourself, or tell me to go ahead (for example by lifting the fence on `config/`) and I'll make it, rerun the tests and check the second failure. Since the config is shared with ops, you may want to check with them first.

The second failure has the same cause as the first. The 12 MB test expects the message "max 10 MB" but gets "max 5 MB", because it also reads `maxMb: 5`. Changing that one value in `config/default.json` should fix both failing tests. I haven't run the tests with the change.
